title: Generalized Gauduchon metrics on compact complex spaces
summary: Let $X$ be an irreducible reduced compact complex space of dimension $n$, and let $ω$ be a Hermitian metric on $X$. For each $1\le k\le n-1$, we prove that there exist a constant $c_k$ and a smooth positive function $ρ$ on $X_{\mathrm{reg}}$ such that $\ii\partial\bar\partial(ρω^k)\wedgeω^{n-k-1}=c_kρω^n$. The function $ρ$ is bounded above and bounded away from zero. The constant $c_k$ is unique, and $ρ$ is unique up to a positive multiple among bounded smooth positive solutions.
